# Colorizer

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Imaging` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public static class Colorizer
```

Tints a grayscale value-map with a hue and saturation, preserving each pixel's own value or lightness — which is what makes one piece of art yield a whole family of variants.

## Methods

### Apply(Image&lt;Rgba32&gt;, double, double, ColorModel) { #m-apply-sixlabors-imagesharp-image-sixlabors-imagesharp-bac81a }

```csharp
public static Image<Rgba32> Apply(Image<Rgba32> valueMap, double h, double s, ColorModel model);
```

Colorizes a value-map.

**Parameters**

- `valueMap` (`Image<Rgba32>`) - The grayscale source. Not modified.
- `h` (`double`) - Hue in degrees.
- `s` (`double`) - Saturation, 0..1.
- `model` (`ColorModel`) - Which space to interpret the color in.

**Returns.** A new image; the caller owns it.
